name: oneframe-lab
description: A local playground for making 3D content from a single photo, from plug-and-play model nodes.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.page.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run protocol:types && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check
scripts.engine:check: uv run --project engine --frozen ruff check && uv run --project engine --frozen ruff format --check && uv run --project engine --frozen pyright && npm run runtime:check && uv run --project engine --frozen pytest engine
